description: The map's messages: the keys by message number from "first" (the numbers before it are common.json's), and the English text of the original game.

strings.map6_s01.were_you_the_one_who:
{wait1 1.9}Were you the one
who cut the fence?
strings.map6_s01.im_glad_you_made_it:
{wait1 3.0}I'm glad you made it.
I was worried about you.{end}
strings.map6_s01.you_were_worried_where_did:
{wait1 3.6}You were worried!?
Where did you disappear to?
strings.map6_s01.i_want_to_know_whats:
{wait1 2.1}I want to know
what's going on here.
strings.map6_s01.this_may_sound_really_off:
{wait1 3.5}This may sound really off
the wall, but listen to me.
strings.map6_s01.i_havent_gone_crazy_and:
{wait1 3.2}I haven't gone crazy,
and I'm not fooling around.{end}
strings.map6_s01.at_first_i_thought_i:
{wait1 3.7}At first, I thought I was
losing my mind.
strings.map6_s01.by_a_world_of_someones:
{wait1 4.0}By a world of someone's
nightmarish delusions
come to life...
strings.map6_s01.little_by_little_the_invasion:
{wait1 2.9}Little by little
the invasion is spreading...
strings.map6_s01.trying_to_swallow_up:
{wait1 2.8}Trying to swallow up
everything in darkness.
strings.map6_s01.harry_hold_on_a_minute:
{wait1 4.6}Harry.
Hold on a minute.
I don't get it?
strings.map6_s01.look_i_dont_understand_it:
{wait1 3.1}Look, I don't understand
it all myself.
strings.map6_s01.cheryl_is_somewhere_and_she:
{wait1 3.2}Cheryl is somewhere.
And she needs my help.{end}
strings.map6_s01.this_whole_things_been_a:
{wait1 2.8}This whole thing's been
a major blow to you.
strings.map6_s01.the_demon_is_awakening:
{wait1 5.2}The demon is awakening!
Spreading those wings.
strings.map6_s01.i_see_it_all_now:
{wait1 4.4}I see it all, now.
Yes, everything.
strings.map6_s01.hungry_for_sacrifice_the_demon:
{wait1 4.9}Hungry for sacrifice,
the demon will swallow up
the land.
strings.map6_s01.and_whats_more_the_task:
{wait1 3.9}And what's more,
the task is almost finished.
strings.map6_s01.to_seal_this_town_to:
{wait1 5.3}To seal this town to the abyss,
the mark of Samael.
strings.map6_s01.when_it_is_completed_all: {wait1 3.6}When it is completed, all is lost.
strings.map6_s01.even_in_daytime_darkness_will:
{wait1 4.6}Even in daytime,
darkness will cover the sun.
strings.map6_s01.the_dead_will_walk_and:
{wait1 5.8}The dead will walk,
and martyrs will burn
in the fires of hell.
strings.map6_s01.so_what_am_i_supposed:
{wait 3.5}So what am I supposed to do?
I've got to save Cheryl.
strings.map6_s01.the_demon_the_demon_taking:
{wait1 4.6}The demon,
the demon taking that
child's form.
strings.map6_s01.stop_it_before_your_daughter:
{wait1 3.7}Stop it before your daughter
becomes a sacrifice.
strings.map6_s01.go_to_the_lighthouse_on:
{wait1 3.0}Go to the lighthouse
on the lake,
strings.map6_s01.and_to_the_center_of:
{wait1 3.5}and to the center of
the amusement park.
strings.map6_s01.make_haste_you_are_the:
{wait1 3.5}Make haste.
You are the only hope.{end}
strings.map6_s01.i_really_dont_get_whats:
{wait 2.1}I really don't get
what's going on.
strings.map6_s01.but_if_theres_a_chance:
{wait 4.4}But if there's a chance
we can save your daughter,
I'm in.
strings.map6_s01.only_with_that_can_you:
{wait 3.2}Only with that can you
stop it.{end}
strings.map6_s01.that_creeps_sure_to_show:
{wait 3.5}That creep's sure to show up
at the Amusement Park
pretty soon.
strings.map6_s01.theres_a_body_stuck_to:
There's a body stuck
to the bulkhead.{end}
